title: Remove every copy
prompt: Return a new array that has everything from items except any item equal to value.
hints: Make a new empty array. For each item, append it only if it is not the value.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: list.append(value)
docs.what: Adds value to the end of the array. Returns nothing.
